import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
sns.histplot(data['amount'], kde=True, color='skyblue')
plt.title('Transaction Amount Distribution')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
sns.histplot(data['hour_of_day'], bins=24, discrete=True, color='orange')
plt.title('Transactions by Hour of Day')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=data, palette='coolwarm')
plt.title('Amount by Transaction Type')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
